name: Elemental Companion I
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level druid 4

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 creature of animal type

DESCRIPTION

As elemental body I.

It is possible to use the same variant to create elemental companion II, III and IV from elemental body II, III and IV.
